Licence check, applied by a reviewer reading the recorded nodes; nothing runs.

Read the dependent against each recorded prerequisite in turn. (1) against mwwxxzyk — no element of the dependent contradicts mwwxxzyk; fail on any contradicting element, naming the element. (2) against qqmrtwor — no element of the dependent contradicts qqmrtwor; fail on any contradicting element, naming the element.

An element contradicts a prerequisite when it forbids, reverses or substitutes an outcome that prerequisite fixes, or narrows the prerequisite by excepting a case the prerequisite covers.

The check presumes no element of the dependent and no particular prerequisite clause: which element is at issue is a finding named only in the check's output. It requires no wording, sentence order or vocabulary of the dependent, restates no element of it, defines its scope in no way, and invents no rule the prerequisites do not state.

A placeholder, empty or ref-less commitment in the dependent, or in a prerequisite the check is read against, leaves the check with no recorded subject: fail, naming the placeholder.
content.rationale:
vvzptxmz uses mwwxxzyk for the entries it gives a focus outline: those entries are the visible links mwwxxzyk presents, so the outline hangs on a presentation mwwxxzyk settles rather than on one this node re-decides, and which entries are links and when they are focusable stay mwwxxzyk's. It uses qqmrtwor for the colour that outline spends: the accent role is the recorded value the outline takes, so this node spends that role and does not substitute a colour of its own. vvzptxmz is, per the layer plan, an inline prose commitment (natural layer); mwwxxzyk is a commitment in words (natural layer); qqmrtwor is an inline visual-spec, one element/aspect/state/value/token tuple (structured layer). The mwwxxzyk edge therefore sits in the matrix's natural-to-natural gate cell (evals/natural-to-natural.md), whose check is copied above as the licence check. The qqmrtwor edge sits in a cell the matrix has no row for — a structured parent used by a natural child — so it takes the documented default, that same gate form, and is flagged here as a matrix gap: no eval-matrix cell covers structured-to-natural, exactly as lvqyqozt flagged for its own structured-to-natural edge and kkulloyx for a visual-spec parent with a prose child. One criterion covers both edges because both ask one question of one dependent text, whether it contradicts a prerequisite it was drawn against, and splitting them would gate one layer shape twice.

The strictness stays at non-contradiction because the child is a commitment in words: whether the outline is drawn while the entry has focus and whether its colour resolves to the recorded role are observables of an artifact, and this dependent is not one. Demanding them here would exceed the licence these edges give and would gate a code-layer subject that no recorded decision has become yet; they are gated where the viewer becomes code. The criterion defines vvzptxmz in no way, restates nothing of it, names no element of either endpoint in advance, and tracks no wording, so it survives a rewording that leaves the decision's content unchanged.
